@pytest.mark.parametrize("account, export_id", [("Acme Holdings", "e-4"), ("Smith & Co", "e-5")])
def test_list_exports_with_special_characters_in_account(client, account, export_id):

    for _ in range(2):
        assert [e.id for e in client.list_exports(account)] == [export_id]
